period_note: Solo (bank-only) Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account from National Bank's Q1-2016 unaudited financial statements (clean digital pdftotext, no OCR needed, but the source PDF's own text layer has scattered character-level corruption in some cells). Plain 'Balance Sheet (Un-audited)'/'Profit and Loss Account (Un-audited)' sections used. Comparative column (31 Dec 2015) reproduces this dataset's existing FY2015 equity of 33557.96m exactly. total_assets and total_deposits were not directly legible (corrupted cells) and were derived: total_assets = Total Liabilities + Total Equity (243932.01 + 33606.12 = 277538.12, which also matches the separately-legible 'TOTAL LIABILITIES AND SHAREHOLDERS EQUITY' figure of 277,538,122,698 exactly); total_deposits = Total Liabilities - Borrowings - Subordinated bond - Other liabilities (243932.01 - 7564.18 - 1280.00 - 23755.01 = 211332.82), consistent with a garbled '211...' fragment visible in the source text. interest_income and interest_expense are marked unavailable: the source text's 'Interest income' row shows only a single legible number (4,819,797,107) which, on cross-checking against this dataset's own 2015_Q1.json, turns out to be the PRIOR-YEAR (Jan-Mar 2015) comparative value that bled into the wrong column during text extraction, not the current period's own figure -- the current period's interest income and interest paid cells are both unrecoverable from this particular filing's corrupted text. net_interest_income (390.27m) is NOT affected by this issue: it is confirmed independently via the full downstream identity chain (Total Operating Income = NII + Investment Income + Commission + Other Income = 3490.83m; minus Total Operating Expenses 1176.68m = Profit Before Provision 2314.15m, which matches a surviving '...147,170' text fragment; minus Total Provision 1630.00m = Profit Before Tax 684.15m, which matches a directly-legible figure exactly; minus Tax 300.00m = PAT 384.15m, exactly matching the directly-legible 'Net Profit after taxation' figure). RESTATEMENT: EPS is 0.22 as reported contemporaneously in this filing; a LATER filing (2017_Q1's own Jan-Mar-2016 comparative column, read directly from a clean page image) shows the SAME PAT of 384,147,170 but a retroactively bonus-share-adjusted 'Earnings per share (Re-stated)' of 0.19 instead. Per this dataset's standing rule, the contemporaneous 0.22 is kept; both figures are recorded here and in sources.json. No NAV-per-share line was legible in this filing; nav_per_share is calculated.
